meta.title: About | Gama Institute
meta.description: The mission, vision and values of Gama Institute.

hero.h1: World-class research, from Quebec to francophone Africa.
hero.lead: GAMA Institute is a research, training and innovation institute in artificial intelligence and software engineering. We train the next generation of researchers and make research accessible across the francophone world.

mission.h2: Advancing research. Training talent. Turning ideas into impact.
mission.lead: We produce world-class research in artificial intelligence and software engineering, while training the next generation of francophone scientific talent through research projects, training programs, and academic and industry collaboration.

vision.h2: A scientific francophonie connected to the world
vision.lead: We imagine a Quebec and a francophone Africa collaborating naturally on international AI and software engineering research, a scientific bridge between our two communities.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: The best breakthroughs happen when researchers, universities and companies work together.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: Outreach, training and shared knowledge, so research benefits everyone.

items.title: Transmission
items.body: We train the next generation by putting them on real research projects.

items.title: Impact
items.body: Research that goes beyond publications: tools, practices and real-world innovation.

pillars.lead: Each pillar reinforces the others: research feeds training, which fuels innovation, carried by community.

items.title: Research
items.body: Advancing research in AI and software engineering, with reliability at the core.

items.title: Training
items.body: Training the next generation of researchers and engineers, from Quebec to francophone Africa.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: Turning research into tools, prototypes and industry collaborations.

items.title: Community
items.body: Bringing together researchers, students and partners across a shared scientific network.

history.h2: From an idea to a research institute
history.lead: Gama Institute was born from the conviction that software engineering and artificial intelligence must evolve together, with reliability as the first requirement.

items.title: First works
items.body: A group of researchers and engineers begins work on the reliability of AI systems.

items.title: Institute founded
items.body: Official creation of Gama Institute and definition of the five research areas.

items.title: Training launched
items.body: Launch of the first course catalogue and the first professional workshops.

items.title: WeekPaper & community
items.body: Start of the WeekPaper series and growth of an open community of practitioners.

items.title: Partnerships at scale
items.body: Academic, industry and government collaborations on responsible-AI projects.

cta.h2: Let's build the future of francophone research together
cta.body: Student, researcher, professor or industry partner: join a community advancing AI and software engineering through research and collaboration.
